[SWS_DM_00124] Limited clearing of UDS DTC status byte during a clear DTC operation
⌈
If the DM is requested to clear a DTC with a forbidden clear
according to [SWS_DM_00896] and a DiagnosticEventToTroubleCodeUdsMap-
ping exists with a mapping from this DTC to an event and the event has Diag-
nosticEvent.clearEventBehavior set to onlyThisCycleAndReadiness, the
DM shall set the following UDS DTC status bits:
• Bit 1 TestFailedThisOperationCycle to ’0’
• Bit 4 TestNotCompletedSinceLastClear to ’1’
• Bit 5 TestFailedSinceLastClear to ’0’
• Bit 6 TestNotCompletedThisOperationCycle to ’1’
and leave all other bits unchanged.
⌋
